about: Shorts waiting to be posted, oldest first. To add one: put the .mp4 in site/media/shorts/ and add an entry here. The publisher posts the first entry not yet in posted.json.

items.title: Your car payment could cost you $78,000
items.caption:
$1,000 a month for 5 years is $60,000 in car payments.
Invested instead at around 10% a year, the same money could have grown to about $78,000.
The car loses value. The investment can grow. (Returns are not guaranteed.)

items.title: Your bank pays you 0.5% and charges you 20%
items.caption:
A traditional savings account can pay as little as 0.5% a year.
The same bank's credit card can charge 20% or more.
That gap is how banks make money from you.

items.title: When bread cost 200 billion marks
items.caption:
Germany, 1923. Prices doubled again and again until one loaf of bread cost about 200 billion marks.
This is what hyperinflation looks like.
